reason: I really am entering a new country in the next few months and I don't have a network there, so trade fairs and referrals won't carry me this time. A free list of 15 companies and a pilot where bad meetings are free and the most I can lose is EUR 900 is cheaper than one month of a junior SDR, so I'd try it in relationship mode, with me approving every message.
objection: My business runs on personal trust, and I don't want an agency from Sofia spamming my future buyers in my name and burning the market before I even arrive. Also, the 45 meetings were for a logistics client, not a wholesaler like me, so I'm not sure the meetings will be buyers who actually place orders rather than people being polite on a call.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies are names I already know or obviously wrong for my niche, I walk away and just buy Apollo and hire a junior myself.
